title: Common
description: Shared definitions for node protocol messages.

OpenGen.title: OpenGen
OpenGen.description: How many times the session has been opened; +1 on every resume.

ImageRef.title: ImageRef
ImageRef.description: An image the user attached to a message (at_attachments). The daemon downloads it with GET <console>/nodes/attachments/<id> and its node token, then hands it to the runtime: Claude gets an image content block (a document block for a PDF), Codex a localImage input item (a PDF is saved and its path named in the text).

CallId.title: CallId
CallId.description: Platform tool call id: tc_ + ULID, generated by the daemon.

UploadId.title: UploadId
UploadId.description: File upload id (up_ + ULID), generated by the daemon.

DownloadId.title: DownloadId
DownloadId.description: File download id (dn_ + id), generated by the console for read_deliverable and read_shared_file.

ExportId.title: ExportId
ExportId.description: Session move id (mv_ + ULID), generated by the console: session.export, session.exported, session.open.import and /nodes/moves/{id}.

RelPath.title: RelPath
RelPath.description: Path relative to the daemon root; never absolute.

Repo.title: Repo
Repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, or git/<id> for a standalone Git repository (with remote_url).

RuntimeID.title: RuntimeID
RuntimeID.description: Runtime id as an open lower-case string (the values of Runtime plus any runtime a newer daemon knows); used as map key and in lists where a new runtime should need no protocol change.

PermissionMode.title: PermissionMode
PermissionMode.description: Claude permission mode; always explicit. The console opens writing members in bypassPermissions (with allow_dangerously_skip_permissions) or default (ask roles), and the coordinator, lead and read-only roles in dontAsk. auto is kept for old consoles only.

ContextUsage.title: ContextUsage
ContextUsage.description: How much of the context window a session uses (shared-members.md §5.3).

used_tokens.description: Tokens in the context now (Claude: getContextUsage totalTokens; Codex: the last request's total tokens).

max_tokens.description: The window the runtime measures against (Claude: the autocompact window; Codex: the model's context window); 0 when unknown.

SshServer.title: SshServer
SshServer.description: A remote server a session may reach through the console's SSH gateway (remote-servers.md §7). name is the server's name in the owner's settings and the Host alias in the session's ssh_config.
